♦ Current Account is primarily meant for businessmen, firms, companies, public enterprises etc. that have numerous daily banking transactions.
♦ In a Current Account, a customer can deposit any amount for any number of times. He can also withdraw any amount as many times as customer wants, subject to availability of fund in the account.
♦ Current Accounts are meant neither for the purpose of earning interest nor for the purpose of Savings but only for convenience of the business.

What is Saving Account ?
A safe and easy way to save your money is with a bank savings account. A bank savings account allows you to deposit money (add money to your account) or withdraw money (remove money from your account) at any time. In return for keeping your money at the bank, the bank pays you money, also known as interest.
Interest will be earned on the money you have on deposit at the bank. Since you may deposit or withdraw money each day, the bank will calculate how much money you should receive in interest. You will also receive a periodic statement from the bank listing your deposits, withdrawals, interest, and account balances. Passbook is also given to the depositors.

Why Saving Account with Us ?
The Savings Accounts from The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Limited. promises you a unique banking experience through innovative features and very good services. It provides you with a host of benefits to take care of all your banking needs. Opening a saving account with us is easy and speedy. 2.75 % of interest is being given to the depositors.

What is Fixed Deposit ?
A fixed deposit is meant for those investors who want to deposit a lump sum of money for a fixed period; say for a minimum period of 15 days to ten years, thereby earning a higher rate of interest in return. Investor gets a lump sum (principal + interest) at the maturity of the deposit.
Bank's fixed deposit scheme is one of the most common savings scheme for an average investor. Fixed deposit also gives a higher rate of interest than a savings bank account. Some of the facilities offered by bank on fixed deposit are overdraft (loan) facility on the amount deposited, premature withdrawal before maturity period (which involves a loss of interest) etc. Bank deposits are fairly safer because banks are subject to under control of the Reserve Bank of India.

Why Fixed Deposit with Us ?
Bank deposits are the safest investment after Post office savings because all bank deposits are insured under the Deposit Insurance & Credit Guarantee Scheme of India. It is possible to get a loans up to 75- 90% of the deposit amount from banks against fixed deposit receipts. The interest charged will be 1% more than the rate of interest earned by the depositers. The Finance Bill Proposals introduced tax deduction at source (TDS) on fixed deposits on interest incomes of Rs.40000/- and above per annum. We give best interest rate on fixed deposit as under.

What is Recurring Deposit?
Recurring Deposit scheme is meant for investors who want to deposit a fixed amount every month, in order to get a lump sum after one to five years. The scheme, a systematic way for long term savings, is one of the best investment option for the low income groups.

Why Recurring Deposit with Us ?
The minimum investment in our bank Recurring Deposit Account is Rs 100/- and then in multiples of Rs. 100/-. The upper limit for investment is Rs. 1000/-. Anyone can open this account in their personal name. Two or more individuals can open combine account. The bank will provide passbook to depositor and depositor have to take passbook when they come for deposit monthly installment or close account. The bank don't take any commission on monthly installment deposit from depositor.

Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank provides an *Education Loan* to support students who want to pursue education in India or abroad. This loan is aimed at assisting rural and local students financially so that they can continue their studies without monetary constraint.
Key Features
► Purpose of Loan
The loan is intended to cover educational expenses such as:

♦ Tuition fees
♦ College/university charges
♦ Examination fees
♦ Hostel & mess charges
♦ Books, equipment, etc.
► Eligibility Criteria

♦ Indian nationals admitted to recognized courses in India or abroad.
♦ Courses recognized by state governments, universities, professional councils, etc.
♦ Covers various levels of education including higher secondary to Ph.D. (but not nursery, primary, or correspondence courses).
► Loan Amount

♦ The *quantum of loan* depends on the actual cost of education and the bank’s assessment of financial need.
♦ It typically covers fees and other essential expenses.
► Security
♦ Requires *one co-obligant (co-applicant)* and *two personal sureties* acceptable to the bank.
How It Works
Application & Documentation
While detailed forms and document lists are available for download on the bank’s website (Education Loan forms), specific documentation requirements typically include:

1. Admission/offer letter
2. Identity & address proofs
3. Academic records
4. Income proof of parents/guardian
5. Co-applicant/surety details
(Exact list should be confirmed with the branch clerk at time of application.)

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. endeavours to safeguard and ensure the security of the information provided by the Customer. The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. uses 128-bit encryption, for the transmission of the information, which is currently the permitted maximum level of encryption in India. The Customer would be required to cooperate with the The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. in order to ensure the security of the information, and it is recommended that the Customers use 128-Bit encryption and must necessarily choose their passwords carefully such that no unauthorized access is made by a third party. Failure to comply with this obligation shall be deemed a serious breach of the terms herein and shall entitle The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. to terminate the services, without prejudice to recover any damages, to which the Customer may be liable.

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. will limit the collection and use of Customer information only on a need-to-know basis to deliver better service to the Customers. The Sabarkantha DCC Bank is a cooperative bank serving individual and business customers in the Sabarkantha district of Gujarat. It offers savings and current accounts, deposits, and a range of loan products to support personal and commercial financial needs.
Loan Products Available
The Sabarkantha DCC Bank provides a variety of loan facilities, including:

Personal Business Cash-Credit Loan
Designed to support the working capital needs of small businesses and entrepreneurs.

Business/Industry Development Loan
Aimed at financing business expansion, purchasing equipment, or capital investment.
Key Features
Personal Business Cash-Credit Loan

♦ Purpose:* Helps individuals or small businesses access short-term funds for daily business operations or working capital needs.
♦ Flexible:* Can be used to support cash flow gaps, purchase inventory, or cover business expenses.
♦ Eligibility:* Typically for business owners or professionals with satisfactory banking history and cooperative membership.
♦ Repayment:* Structured as per bank’s policy (monthly/quarterly) with interest applicable on utilized amount. ([skbank.co.in][1])
Business / Industry Development Loan

♦ Purpose:* For business setup, expansion, machinery purchase, or development projects outside agriculture.
♦ Target:* Micro, small business units & local industrial activity.
♦ Customization:* Loan terms, limits, and repayment schedules personalized based on business viability.
Benefits

✅Support for Small Business Growth* – Helps local entrepreneurs manage and expand their business. ([skbank.co.in][1])
✅Flexible Credit Options* – Cash-credit facility for short-term needs with revolving access to funds. ([skbank.co.in][1])
✅ Local Cooperative Focus* – Cooperative structure often results in community-based customer service. ([skdccb.bank.in][3])
Who Can Apply ?

✔ Business owners and entrepreneurs in *Sabarkantha district*
✔ Individuals with documented business activity
✔ Members of Sabarkantha DCC Bank with satisfactory repayment history
How to Apply

1. Visit your *nearest The Sabarkantha DCC Bank branch*
2. Fill out the loan application form
3. Submit required *KYC & business documents*
4. Bank will assess credit worthiness and evaluate loan terms

Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. offers *Business Loans* to support entrepreneurs, traders, professionals, self-employed persons, and small & medium enterprises in meeting their working capital and business expansion needs. The loan is designed to promote local trade, industry, and economic development within the district.
Key Features

♦ Financial support for starting, expanding, or modernizing business activities
♦ Suitable for traders, manufacturers, service providers, MSMEs, and professionals
♦ Working capital as well as term loan facilities available
♦ Competitive interest rates as per bank norms
♦ Flexible repayment options linked to business cash flows
Purpose of Loan

♦ Purchase of raw materials and inventory
♦ Business expansion or diversification
♦ Purchase of machinery, equipment, and tools
♦ Renovation or improvement of business premises
♦ Meeting day-to-day working capital requirements
Eligibility

♦ Individuals, proprietorships, partnerships, firms, and eligible institutions
♦ Existing business with satisfactory financial performance
♦ Good credit history and banking relationship with the bank
♦ Compliance with bank and regulatory guidelines
Security

♦ Hypothecation of stocks, receivables, or business assets
♦ Mortgage of immovable property, if required
♦ Personal/third-party guarantee as per bank policy
Repayment

♦ Monthly / quarterly installments or overdraft limits
♦ Repayment period based on nature of loan and business viability
Documents Required

♦ Loan application form
♦ KYC documents (Identity & Address proof)
♦ Business registration and licenses
♦ Financial statements / income details
♦ Bank account statements

Provided by the bank to a group of individuals (usually 4–10 members) who jointly take responsibility for repayment. The group members provide mutual guarantee for the loans availed by each member, enabling access to formal credit even without land title or other security. This mechanism is widely used in rural credit programs to support small and marginal farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, rural micro-entrepreneurs, and others in similar economic activities.

♦ Promote financial inclusion by extending institutional credit to underserved rural clients.
♦ Support *agriculture, allied activities, non-farm enterprises, and income-generating activities* without requiring collateral/security.
♦ Build credit discipline and peer support among group members.
Who Can Form a JLG?

While The Sabarkantha DCC Bank’s specific eligibility details are typically provided at the branch level, Joint Liability Groups generally have the following membership norms (common across banks offering JLG loans): ([Wikipedia][2])

✔ 4 to 10 members
✔ Members should be from the same village or neighbourhood and similar socio-economic background
✔ Members should be engaged in income-generating activity (agri or non-agri)
✔ Members must trust and mutually guarantee one another for loan repayment
✔ Members with past loan defaults are usually not eligible to join the group
Loan Features
While exact figures are finalized by the bank and may vary by policy, typically JLG loan features include:
Collateral / Security

♦ No collateral/security required — loan is backed by mutual guarantee of group members.
♦ Primary risk coverage is the *joint liability undertaking* of the group.
Loan Amount

♦ Individual members can receive credit based on their activity and repayment capacity.
♦ Many cooperative and district banks offer up to *₹1,00,000 per member, and the *group limit often aggregates to a higher total (e.g., up to ₹5,00,000 or more depending on bank policy). Exact limits should be confirmed with the bank.
Interest Rates

♦ Interest rates are decided by the bank as per internal lending policy and may be subject to regulatory guidelines.
♦ Cooperative banks generally offer competitive priority sector rates to small farmers and rural entrepreneurs.
Repayment Period
♦ Repayment tenure usually depends on the purpose of the loan — short-term for crop/working capital and longer stretches for investment activities.
Documents Needed

While The Sabarkantha DCC Bank will require specific forms, banks typically ask for:
📌 KYC documents (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, etc.)
📌 JLG membership and formation documents
📌 Loan application form
📌 Joint Liability Group agreement (inter se agreement)
📌 DP Note (Demand Promissory Note)

blocks.text: તારીખ: ૦૧/૦૫/૨૦૧૫ થી "The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank" દ્વારા અટલ પેન્શન યોજના (APY), પ્રધાનમંત્રી જીવન જ્યોતિ વીમા યોજના (PMJJBY) અને પ્રધાનમંત્રી સુરક્ષા વીમા યોજના (PMSBY) શરુ કરવામાં આવેલ છે. આ વિવિધ યોજનાઓના મહત્વનાં મુદ્દા ની વધુ માહિતી માટે નીચે આપેલ સરકારી યોજના પર ક્લિક કરો અથવા અમારી બેંકની નજીકની શાખાનો સંપર્ક કરવો.
અટલ પેન્શન યોજના (APY) "Minimum Investment, Maximum Benefits During Old Age"
⇒ ભારત સરકાર દ્વારા અટલ પેન્શન યોજના (APY) તરીકે ઓળખાતી નવી યોજના જાહેર કરવામાં આવી છે. APY ખાતરી પેન્શન યોજના છે અને પેન્શન ફંડ રેગ્યુલેટરી એન્ડ ડેવલપમેન્ટ ઓથોરિટી (PFRDA) દ્વારા સંચાલિત છે.
⇒ આ યોજનામાં જોડાવા માટે ઓછામાં ઓછી વય ૧૮ વર્ષ અને મહત્તમ વય મર્યાદા ૪૦ વર્ષ રહેશે.
⇒ બેંકમાં બચતખાતુ ધરાવનાર વ્યક્તિને જ આ યોજનાનો લાભ મળી શકશે. અથવા બચતખાતુ ન હોય તો નવીન બચતખાતુ ખોલાવીને આ યોજનાનો લાભ મેળવી શકાશે.
⇒ વૃદ્ધવસ્થા દરમ્યાન આવકની સલામતી.
⇒ ૬૦ વર્ષની ઉંમરથી રૂ. ૧૦૦૦/- થી રૂ. ૫૦૦૦/- સુધીનું જ માસિક પેન્શન.
⇒ સ્વૈચ્છિક રીતે નિવૃત્તિ સમય માટેનું રોકાણ આ યોજનાનો હેતુ છે.
⇒ આ યોજનાનો વહીવટ "પેન્શન ફંડ રેગ્યુલેટરી એન્ડ ડેવલપમેન્ટ ઓથોરીટી (PFRDA) ભારત સરકાર દ્વારા કરાશે.
⇒ ફાળાનું સ્તર વ્યક્તિની ઉંમર સાથે સંકળાયેલ રહેશે. નાની ઉંમરમાં જોડાનાર વ્યક્તિને ઓછો ફાળો તથા મોટી ઉંમર માટે વધારે રહેશે.

⇒ આ યોજના રોકાણ માટે પ્રોત્સાહન આપવા તા. ૩૧/૧૨/૨૦૧૫ પહેલા નવું ખાતું ખોલાવનારને કેન્દ્ર સરકાર દ્વારા ખાતેદારને દર વર્ષે મહત્તમ રૂ. ૧૦૦૦/- ની મર્યાદામાં અથવા વર્ષ દરમ્યાનના કુલ ફાળાના ૫૦% બે માંથી જે ઓછું હશે તે PFRDA મારફતે સબસીડી રૂપે જમા કરવામાં આવશે (૨૦૧૫-૨૦૧૬ થી ૨૦૧૯-૨૦૨૦ સુધી)
⇒ આયકર ચુકવતા ખાતેદારો તેમજ કોઈપણ પેન્શન યોજનામાં જોડાયેલ ખાતેદાર આ યોજનામાં જોડાઈ શકશે પરંતુ ઉપરના મુદ્દા પ્રમાણે સબસીડીનો લાભ મળવાપાત્ર રહેશે નહી.

Privacy Statement

In the course of using this website or availing the products and services vide the online application forms and questionnaires, The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. may become privy to the personal information of its Customers, including information that is of a confidential nature.

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. is strongly committed to protecting the privacy of its Customers and has taken all reasonable measures to protect the confidentiality of the Customer information and its transmission through the world wide web and it shall not be held liable in any manner for disclosure of the confidential information in accordance with this Privacy Commitment or in terms of the agreements, if any, with the Customers or by reasons beyond its control.

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. endeavours to safeguard and ensure the security of the information provided by the Customer. The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. uses 128-bit encryption, for the transmission of the information, which is currently the permitted maximum level of encryption in India. The Customer would be required to cooperate with the The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. in order to ensure the security of the information, and it is recommended that the Customers use 128-Bit encryption and must necessarily choose their passwords carefully such that no unauthorized access is made by a third party. To make the password complex and difficult for other to guess, the Customers should use a combination of alphabets, numbers and special characters like !, @, #, $ etc. The Customers should not disclose their password(s) to anyone or keep any written or other record of the password(s) such that a third party could access it.

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. undertakes not to disclose the information provided by the Customers to any person, unless such action is necessary to: -a) Conform to legal requirements or comply with legal process:
b) Protect and defend The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. rights, interests or property;
c) Enforce the terms and conditions of the products or services; or
d) Act to protect the interests of The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd., or its members, or of other persons.

e) The Customer authorizes The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. to exchange, share, part with all information related to the details and transaction history of the Customers to banks / financial institutions / credit bureaus / agencies / participation in any telecommunication or electronic clearing network as may be required by law, customary practice, credit reporting, statistical analysis and credit scoring, verification or risk management and shall not hold The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. liable for use or disclosure of this information.

The Customers shall not disclose to any other person, in any manner whatsoever, any information relating to The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. of a confidential nature obtained in the course of availing the services through the website. Failure to comply with this obligation shall be deemed a serious breach of the terms herein and shall entitle The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. to terminate the services, without prejudice to recover any damages, to which the Customer may be liable.

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. will limit the collection and use of Customer information only on a need-to-know basis to deliver better service to the Customers. The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. may use and share the information provided by the Customers and third parties for providing services, and notifying or contacting the Customers regarding any problem with, or the expiration of, such services.

blocks.text: The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. provides *Cheque Truncation System (CTS)* facility to ensure faster, safer, and more efficient cheque clearing for its customers.

CTS is an electronic cheque clearing system introduced by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), where physical movement of cheques is eliminated and cheque images are transmitted electronically for clearing and settlement.
Key Features of CTS

♦ Faster cheque clearance compared to traditional clearing
♦ Secure and reliable electronic image-based processing
♦ Reduction in cheque loss, delay, and fraud risks
♦ Uniform clearing standards across banks
Benefits to Customers:

♦ Quicker realization of cheque proceeds
♦ Improved transparency in cheque processing
♦ Reduced turnaround time for local and outstation cheques
♦ Environment-friendly system with reduced paper handling
The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. remains committed to providing modern, secure, and customer-friendly banking services through the CTS facility.

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. provides convenient and secure *ATM Facility* to its customers, enabling them to access banking services anytime, anywhere. The Bank’s ATMs are connected to national ATM networks, ensuring wide accessibility across India.
Key Features of ATM Facility:

♦ 24x7 cash withdrawal facility
♦ Balance enquiry and mini statement
♦ Fast, safe, and easy access to funds
♦ Interoperable usage at other bank ATMs across India
♦ Secure transactions with PIN-based authentication

The ATM Facility of The Sabarkantha DCC Bank ensures greater convenience, reduces the need to visit branches frequently, and offers customers round-the-clock banking services. Customers are advised to follow safe ATM practices to protect their card and PIN information.
The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. provides *Micro ATM Facility* to ensure easy, secure, and doorstep banking services for customers, especially in rural and semi-urban areas.
Key Features & Benefits:

♦ Enables basic banking transactions through handheld Micro ATM devices
♦ Aadhaar-based authentication using fingerprint/IRIS for secure access
♦ Cash withdrawal facility from customer’s bank account
♦ Balance enquiry and mini statement services
♦ Interoperable service – customers of other banks can also use the facility
♦ Real-time transaction processing through NPCI network
♦ Reduces the need to visit bank branches or ATMs
♦ Promotes financial inclusion and digital banking

How it Works:
Customers can visit authorized Bank Mitras/Business Correspondents of The Sabarkantha DCC Bank. By providing their *Aadhaar number* and completing biometric verification, transactions can be carried out instantly through the Micro ATM.
Eligibility:

♦ Aadhaar-linked bank account holders
♦ Savings Bank account customers
Security:

♦ Biometric authentication ensures high-level security
♦ Transactions are processed in real time with instant confirmation
The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. is committed to delivering convenient, accessible, and technology-driven banking services to its customers through the Micro ATM Facility.

The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. offers *UPI (Unified Payments Interface)* to provide customers with a fast, secure, and convenient digital payment experience. UPI enables instant fund transfers directly from your bank account using a mobile phone, anytime and anywhere.
Key Features

♦ Instant Payments:* Send and receive money in real time, 24×7, including holidays.
♦ Multiple Payment Options:* Pay using UPI ID, mobile number, QR code, or bank account details.
♦ Single Mobile App:* Access multiple bank accounts through one UPI-enabled app.
♦ No Need to Share Bank Details:* Transactions are completed using a UPI ID or QR code.
♦ Bill Payments & Merchant Payments:* Pay utility bills, recharge, and shop online or at stores.
Benefits to Customers

* Simple, fast, and paperless transactions
* Secure payments with *UPI PIN authentication*
* Low or zero transaction charges as per NPCI/RBI guidelines
* Ideal for daily transactions and small-value payments
Registration Process

♦ Customer must have an active savings/current account with the Bank
♦ Mobile number should be registered with the Bank
♦ Download a UPI-enabled mobile app and complete one-time registration
♦ Create your UPI ID and set UPI PIN using debit card details
Safety & Security

♦ Two-factor authentication for every transaction
♦ UPI PIN ensures complete control and protection
♦ Customers are advised *not to share UPI PIN, OTP, or card details* with anyone

The Sabarkantha DCC Bank offers the *Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS)* facility, a centralized and interoperable bill payment platform introduced by the *Reserve Bank of India (RBI)* and operated by *NPCI Bharat BillPay*. BBPS enables customers to pay multiple utility and service bills securely, conveniently, and on time through the Bank.

Bills & Services Covered
Customers can pay a wide range of bills under BBPS, including:

♦ Electricity, Water & Gas Bills
♦ Telephone (Landline & Mobile Postpaid) Bills
♦ DTH & Broadband Bills
♦ Municipal Taxes & Property Tax
♦ Insurance Premiums
♦ Education Fees and other notified services
Modes of Payment

♦ Savings / Current Account
♦ Debit Card
♦ Internet Banking / Mobile Banking (where available)
♦ Cash payment at Bank Branches (as permitted)
Key Features & Benefits

♦ One-stop solution* for multiple bill payments
♦ Anytime, anywhere* bill payment facility
♦ Instant confirmation* with transaction receipt
♦ Safe & secure* platform backed by RBI & NPCI
♦ Interoperable system* – pay bills of various billers on a single platform
♦ Timely payments* helping avoid late fees and service disruptions
Customer Convenience

♦ Access BBPS services at The Sabarkantha DCC Bank branches and approved digital channels
♦ Transparent charges, if any, as per Bank norms
♦ Dedicated support for bill payment-related queries

The *National Automated Clearing House (NACH)* is a centralized, web-based system developed by *NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India)* to facilitate high-volume, recurring electronic transactions in a safe, efficient, and time-bound manner. The Sabarkantha District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd. offers NACH services to its customers for seamless debit and credit transactions.
Features of NACH

♦ Enables *paperless and automated recurring payments*
♦ Suitable for *bulk and repetitive transactions*
♦ Faster processing with standardized formats
♦ Secure and reliable system governed by NPCI
♦ Reduces operational costs and manual intervention
NACH Credit Facility
NACH Credit is used for bulk credit transactions such as:

♦ Salary payments
♦ Pension disbursements
♦ Dividend and interest payments
♦ Subsidies and government benefit transfers
This facility ensures timely and accurate credit to beneficiaries’ accounts.
NACH Debit Facility
NACH Debit enables automatic collection of recurring payments such as:

♦ Loan EMIs
♦ Insurance premiums
♦ Utility bill payments
♦ Subscription and membership fees
Customers can authorize institutions to debit their accounts periodically, ensuring timely payments without manual follow-up.
Benefits to Customers

♦ Convenience of *auto-debit and auto-credit*
♦ Eliminates the risk of missed payments
♦ Saves time and effort
♦ Transparent and trackable transactions
Benefits to Institutions

♦ Efficient collection and disbursement mechanism
♦ Improved cash flow management
♦ Reduced paperwork and processing time
► Safeguard Account Credentials Customers must protect their Customer ID, passwords, PINs, OTPs, debit card details, and all other authentication information.
► Do Not Share Confidential Information Login credentials, OTPs, card details, and other confidential information must not be shared with any third party, including Bank staff.
► Use Only Authorized Bank Channels Customers should use only official Bank channels such as the Bank’s website, mobile application, and branch counters for transactions and service requests.
► Immediate Reporting of Suspicious Activities Customers must immediately report the following to the Bank through designated customer support channels:
(A)Any suspicious or unauthorized transactions
(B)Phishing calls, emails, SMS, or fraudulent websites
(C)Loss or compromise of debit cards, credentials, or mobile devices
► Maintain Updated Contact Details Customers should ensure that their registered mobile number and email ID are updated with the Bank to receive transaction alerts and security notifications.
► Follow Cyber Safety Advisories Customers are advised to follow cyber safety guidelines, alerts, and awareness communications issued by the Bank from time to time.

► Cooperate During Investigations Customers are expected to cooperate with the Bank during investigations of suspected fraud or cyber incidents, including providing necessary information or confirmations, as required.
